model.title: Non-road mobile machinery engines: inclusion of hydrogen as a reference fuel for the testing of an engine type or engine family

summary.lead: Official summary (Legislative Observatory, Legislative proposal published):
summary.text: The proposal makes two targeted amendments to Regulation (EU) 2016/1628:
more: - hydrogen is added to the list of "reference fuels " used in type-approval/emissions testing;
- the obligation to provide CO₂ information/reporting is removed where the engine is operated solely on hydrogen, because there is no CO₂ of fuel origin from combustion.

By incorporating hydrogen into the regulatory framework, the initiative supports the EU's strategy to reduce carbon emissions and achieve climate neutrality by 2050. It helps reduce reliance on fossil fuels and contributes to a

Recognising hydrogen as a viable fuel encourages innovation within the NRMM sector, supporting research, development, and deployment of hydrogen technologies. It aligns EU regulations with UNECE standards, facilitating international trade and maintaining the competitiveness of EU manufacturers globally.
